title: HỌA BÌ
subtitle: Bức da vẽ
visualStyle: Chinese manhua horror comic art, confident ink linework with flat muted colors and soft cel shading, eerie palette of moonlit blue-grey and warm candle amber, ancient China in the Ming dynasty era, cinematic camera angles, expressive faces. NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D render.

vuong.name: Vương sinh
vuong.appearance: Chinese man aged 30. BODY: 7.5-head proportion, slender scholar build. FACE: handsome narrow face, thin brows, gentle but weak-willed eyes, clean-shaven. HAIR: long black hair tied in a topknot wrapped with a dark cloth band.

looks.day: OUTFIT: pale blue Ming-style scholar robe (cross-collar hanfu) with wide sleeves, dark sash, black cloth shoes.
looks.night: OUTFIT: plain white cotton inner robe for sleeping, hair loose down to the shoulders, barefoot.

nang.name: người con gái
nang.appearance: Chinese woman, looks about 18. BODY: 7-head proportion, slim and graceful. FACE: breathtakingly beautiful oval face, sad almond eyes, small red lips, pale skin. HAIR: glossy black hair in a low bun with one plain jade hairpin.

looks.beauty: OUTFIT: soft peach-pink hanfu with a pale cross collar and long sleeves, carrying a small cloth bundle.
looks.demon: TRUE FORM — the same figure and the same peach-pink hanfu, but she is a demon: grey-green skin, glowing yellow eyes, a wide mouth full of jagged saw-like teeth, wild loose black hair, long dark claws. Frightening but NOT gory, no blood.

tran.name: Trần thị
tran.appearance: Chinese woman aged 28, Vương sinh's wife. BODY: 7-head proportion, modest. FACE: kind, worried eyes, plain natural beauty. HAIR: neat bun with a wooden hairpin.

looks.home: OUTFIT: dark green simple hanfu with a light inner collar, cloth apron.

daosi.name: đạo sĩ
daosi.appearance: Chinese Taoist priest aged 55. BODY: 7.5-head proportion, lean and upright. FACE: sharp stern eyes, long grey beard and mustache, deep lines. HAIR: grey hair in a topknot held by a wooden Taoist crown pin.

looks.robe: OUTFIT: grey Taoist robe with black trim and a yin-yang patch, cloth shoes, a peachwood sword on his back and a gourd at his belt.

dien.name: người điên
dien.appearance: Chinese beggar man aged 45, the madman of the market. BODY: 7-head proportion, gaunt, hunched. FACE: dirty face, wild grin with missing teeth, piercing eyes that seem secretly wise. HAIR: matted messy hair and beard.

looks.rags: OUTFIT: tattered patched rags, barefoot, holding a crooked walking stick.

thuphong.name: Thư phòng
thuphong.description: A Ming-dynasty scholar's study room at night: wooden lattice window with paper panes, a low writing desk with brushes and an ink stone, a wooden bed with curtains, a candle on a stand, bookshelves

phongngu.name: Phòng ngủ
phongngu.description: A modest Ming-dynasty bedroom at night: wooden door with lattice, a canopy bed, an oil lamp, a folding screen

duong.name: Đường sớm
duong.description: A misty country road outside an ancient Chinese town at dawn, willow trees, a small stone bridge, distant town wall

cho.name: Chợ
cho.description: A busy ancient Chinese market street by day: wooden stalls, cloth awnings, lanterns, stone-paved road, a temple gate in the distance

nhanhilang.name: Nhà Nhị Lang
nhanhilang.description: A small ancient Chinese courtyard house: wooden gate, tiled roof, a well and a stone courtyard

phattran.name: Phất trần
phattran.description: A Taoist horsetail whisk: a polished wooden handle with a long flowing bundle of white horsehair

holo.name: Hồ lô
holo.description: A dried calabash gourd bottle tied with a red cord, a small wooden stopper

1.title: Người đẹp trong sương
1.summary: Vương sinh mê một cô gái lạ, giấu nàng trong thư phòng. Đạo sĩ cảnh báo, Vương gạt đi… cho tới khi nhìn trộm.

2.title: Tấm da vẽ
2.summary: Con quỷ khoác tấm da vẽ, xé phất trần của đạo sĩ, xông vào moi tim Vương.

pages.p: A dramatic comic BOOK COVER, no panels. A close-up of a beautiful young woman's face (nang@beauty) — the right half of her face is peeling away like painted paper, revealing the grey-green demon face with glowing yellow eyes and jagged teeth underneath (nang@demon). A brush dripping ink in the foreground, misty moonlit background. Big title lettering at the top: "HỌA BÌ". Below it smaller: "Bức da vẽ". At the bottom: "Liêu Trai Chí Dị · Tập 1".

panels: Wide: a misty country road at dawn, an ancient town wall far away. Caption box: "Thái Nguyên, một buổi sớm sương mù."
Vương sinh (vuong@day) walking along the road, noticing a lone young woman (nang@beauty) ahead, clutching a cloth bundle.
Vương sinh speaks to her as she turns back nervously. Speech bubble from Vương sinh: "Cô nương đi đâu sớm vậy?"
The young woman (nang@beauty) turns back with teary eyes, clutching her bundle. Speech bubble: "Kẻ khổ như thiếp, chàng hỏi làm chi?"
Vương sinh (vuong@day) steps closer, concerned. Speech bubble: "Nàng có nỗi khổ gì, cứ nói ta nghe."

FLASHBACK in faded sepia tones: inside a rich household, a cruel first wife in fine silk raises a stick to beat the young woman, who cowers. Caption box: "Cha mẹ ham tiền, bán nàng cho nhà giàu. Vợ cả ngày đêm đánh đập."
The woman lowers her head sadly on the misty road. Speech bubble: "Thiếp không chịu nổi nữa, đành bỏ trốn."
Close-up of the eyes of Vương sinh, enchanted and infatuated, gazing at her beauty. Thought bubble: "Đẹp quá… như tiên giáng trần."
Vương sinh smiles warmly and gestures toward the town. Speech bubble: "Nhà ta gần đây. Nàng về tạm lánh."
Vương sinh carries her bundle as they walk toward the town gate; she looks down, and the corner of her lips curls into a faint sinister smile he cannot see. No text.
At the back gate of the house, the two slip inside quietly, Vương sinh glancing around. No text.
Night, the study room lit by a candle: Vương sinh sits close beside the woman, enchanted. Caption box: "Vương giấu nàng trong thư phòng, đêm đêm lui tới."
Night corridor: Trần thị (tran@home) catches her husband sneaking toward the study with a tray of food. Speech bubble from Trần thị: "Chàng giấu ai trong thư phòng?"
Vương sinh (vuong@day) startled and flustered. Speech bubble: "Một cô gái đáng thương thôi."
Trần thị worried, holding her hands together. Speech bubble: "Lỡ nhà giàu đến đòi người… chàng nên cho đi."
Vương sinh turns away dismissively. Speech bubble: "Nàng đừng ghen bóng ghen gió."
Wide establishing shot of the busy ancient market by day. Caption box: "Hôm sau, Vương ra chợ."
A Taoist priest (daosi@robe) blocks the way of Vương sinh and stares at him intently. Speech bubble: "Công tử gặp chuyện gì lạ chăng?"
Vương sinh (vuong@day) shrugs, avoiding his eyes. Speech bubble: "Không có."
BIG dramatic close-up of the piercing eyes of the priest, faint dark mist swirling around Vương sinh behind him. Speech bubble: "Tà khí quấn đầy người, vậy mà bảo không có!"
The priest walks away shaking his head. Speech bubble: "Ngu thay! Có kẻ sắp chết mà không biết."
Vương sinh frozen in the middle of the market, uneasy, people passing by. No text.
Vương sinh walking alone through the crowd, troubled. Thought bubble: "Nàng đẹp như vậy… sao có thể là yêu?"
Dusk: Vương sinh at his garden gate, pushing it but it is bolted. Caption box: "Cổng vườn cài then từ bên trong."
Vương sinh climbing over a crumbling back wall. Thought bubble: "Sao lại cài cửa giữa ban ngày?"
Vương sinh tiptoeing through the dark garden toward the study window glowing with candlelight. No text.
Evening, the study room door shut tight. Caption box: "Về đến nơi, cửa thư phòng đóng chặt."
Vương sinh (vuong@day) pressing himself against the paper window, peeking through a small torn hole, tense.
Extreme close-up of one eye behind the torn hole in the paper window, wide with suspicion. No text.

THE REVEAL seen through the hole: a grey-green demon (nang@demon) with jagged teeth spreads a flat human skin across the bed like a sheet of paper and paints it with a brush. Eerie candlelight. No text. No blood.
BIG PANEL: the grey-green demon (nang@demon) lifts the finished painted human skin and shakes it out like a robe. Caption box: "Vẽ xong, con quỷ giũ tấm da như giũ áo, khoác lên người."
In an instant she is the beautiful young woman again (nang@beauty), adjusting her collar. No text.
She looks into a bronze mirror and smiles sweetly, as if nothing happened. No text.
Vương sinh (vuong@day) stumbles back from the window, both hands clamped over his mouth, drenched in sweat. Thought bubble: "Trời ơi… là quỷ!"
Vương sinh scrambling back over the crumbling wall, shaking. No text.
Vương sinh running wildly down a dark street at night. Caption box: "Vương chạy đi tìm đạo sĩ."
Vương sinh holding a paper lantern, running through narrow alleys, shouting. No text.
Outside the town in a moonlit empty field, the silhouette of the Taoist priest (daosi@robe) standing still. No text.
Vương sinh throws himself to his knees before the priest. Speech bubble: "Xin đạo trưởng cứu mạng!"
The priest sighs, looking at the moon. Speech bubble: "Con quỷ ấy cũng khổ, đang tìm người thế mạng."
Close-up of the conflicted face of the priest. Speech bubble: "Ta không nỡ giết nó."
The priest hands over a horsetail whisk (phattran). Speech bubble: "Treo trước cửa phòng ngủ. Nó sẽ không dám vào."
Vương sinh clutching the whisk, bowing again and again in gratitude. No text.
Vương sinh (vuong@day) hangs the horsetail whisk above the bedroom door. No text.
Vương sinh holds the hands of his wife Trần thị (tran@home), ashamed. Speech bubble: "Nàng nói đúng… ta đã sai."
The couple bar the door and sit huddled beside a single lamp. Caption box: "Đêm ấy, hai vợ chồng không dám ngủ."
The bedroom door seen from inside, a shadow gliding past the paper lattice outside. Caption box: "Canh một." Sound effect lettering: "LẠO XẠO…"
Trần thị (tran@home) covers the mouth of her husband (vuong@night); both hold their breath in terror. No text.
Through the door lattice: the beautiful woman (nang@beauty) stands staring up at the whisk, grinding her teeth. No text.
The woman (nang@beauty) glares at the whisk. Speech bubble: "Đạo sĩ dọa ta ư?"
She rips the whisk down and tears it apart. Speech bubble: "Miếng ăn đến miệng, lẽ nào nhả ra!" Sound effect: "XOẸT!"
BIG PANEL: the bedroom door bursts open violently, splinters flying, the silhouette of the demon (nang@demon) looming in the doorway against the moonlight. Sound effect: "RẦM!"
Trần thị (tran@home) screaming. Speech bubble: "KHÔNG!!!"
BIG PANEL: the demon (nang@demon) in true form pounces onto the bed where Vương sinh (vuong@night) lies — shown as a dark silhouette against the lamp, no blood, no gore.
The demon leaps out through the window into the night, a faint red glow clutched in its claw. Caption box: "Con quỷ moi tim Vương rồi biến mất." No blood.

SPLASH PAGE: Trần thị (tran@home) collapsed over the still body of her husband (vuong@night) under a blanket, weeping by the dim lamp, the torn whisk on the floor. No blood. Caption box: "Vương đã chết."

Early morning: Trần thị (tran@home), eyes red, calls a young man in plain brown clothes (Nhị Lang, the younger brother of Vương, about 22, short topknot). Caption box: "Sáng hôm sau, Trần thị gọi Nhị Lang, em trai Vương."
Trần thị grips the arm of Nhị Lang. Speech bubble: "Chú mau đi tìm đạo sĩ!"
Nhị Lang dashes out of the gate. No text.
The Taoist priest (daosi@robe) hears the news and clenches his fist in fury. Speech bubble: "Ta thương nó mà tha, nó dám làm vậy!"
The priest stands in the courtyard of Vương sinh, scanning the air with narrowed eyes. Speech bubble: "Nó đã trốn sang nhà phía nam."
The young man Nhị Lang (plain brown clothes) stunned. Speech bubble: "Đó… là nhà em!"
At the courtyard house of Nhị Lang. The priest asks him. Speech bubble: "Hôm nay có ai lạ đến không?"
Nhị Lang (plain brown clothes) remembering. Speech bubble: "Sáng nay có một bà lão xin giúp việc."
An old woman with a broom sweeping the courtyard glances sideways; her eyes glint yellow for an instant. No text.
The priest points straight at her. Speech bubble: "Chính là nó!"
The priest draws his peachwood sword. Speech bubble: "Yêu nghiệt! Trả tấm da đây!"
The old woman throws down the broom and runs. No text.
BIG PANEL: the priest strikes; the old-woman disguise falls away like a cloak and the demon (nang@demon) is revealed, shrieking. Sound effect: "XOẠT!" No blood, no gore.
BIG PANEL: the demon dissolves into a towering column of thick swirling black smoke in the courtyard. No text.
The priest uncorks his gourd (holo) and the smoke is sucked inside. Sound effect: "VÙ…"
The priest rolls up the empty painted skin like a scroll painting. Speech bubble: "Thì ra chỉ là tấm da vẽ."
Trần thị (tran@home) kneels, sobbing. Speech bubble: "Xin đạo trưởng cứu chồng con!"
The priest (daosi@robe) shakes his head gravely. Speech bubble: "Ta không thể cải tử hoàn sinh."
The priest points toward the market. Speech bubble: "Ngoài chợ có người điên. Hãy cầu xin hắn, dù bị nhục cũng phải chịu."
Wide shot of the market: a ragged madman (dien@rags) sprawled in the dirt before a small temple gate, singing and laughing. No text.
Trần thị (tran@home) kneels before him. Speech bubble: "Xin ông cứu chồng tôi."
The madman roars with laughter. Speech bubble: "Người đẹp thế này, lấy ta làm chồng đi!"
The madman swings his stick at Trần thị while a crowd gathers, jeering. Caption box: "Bị đánh, bị cười chê, bà vẫn quỳ xin."
Close-up: Trần thị bites her lip, enduring, tears streaming down. No text.

BIG PANEL: the madman picks up a moldy half-eaten bun from the dirt and shoves it at her face. Speech bubble: "Ăn đi! Ăn hết thì ta cứu!" Trần thị shuts her eyes and swallows it while the crowd laughs.
The madman turns and walks into the temple — and is gone without a trace. Caption box: "Người điên vào miếu rồi biến mất."
At home Trần thị embraces the body of her husband (vuong@night), weeping, then suddenly clutches her chest and retches. No text.

A glowing red heart, still beating, leaps from her into the chest of Vương sinh in a burst of warm golden light. Caption box: "Thứ bà nuốt hóa thành trái tim, nhảy vào lồng ngực chồng." Magical, not gory.
BIG PANEL: dawn light through the window, Vương sinh (vuong@night) opens his eyes as Trần thị (tran@home) throws her arms around him. Speech bubble from Vương sinh: "Ta… như vừa qua giấc mộng dài."
Trần thị smiling through tears. No text.
A quiet still-life of the rolled painted-skin scroll on a table beside a brush. Caption box: "Ngu thay người đời! Rõ ràng là yêu mà cho là đẹp." Smaller caption: "Liêu Trai Chí Dị"
